[[File:1944_05_30_Ulus.jpg|thumb]]
The '''1944 National Division''' was the seventh edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] won their second title.

==Participants==
*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Vefa S.K.|Vefa]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*[[İstanbulspor A.Ş.|İstanbulspor]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 5th
*[[Harp Okulu S.K.|Harp Okulu]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 1st
*[[MKE Ankaragücü|AS-FA Ankaragücü]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*[[Göztepe S.K.|UDV Göztepe]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 1st
*[[Karşıyaka S.K.|Karşıyaka]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 2nd
